dq_07.description: Post-2025 CBD fee checks, split: (a) fee amounts limited to {0, expected service amount} with a small anomaly-rate allowance; (b) CRZ-pickup positive-fee rate above a floor. Upper bound removed 2026-07: measured rate 0.9937 for yellow 2025-06 (2,180,684/2,194,584) exceeded the guessed 0.99 cap; near-1.0 is reality, not implausibility. Note pu_zone_id is a proxy — the fee applies on zone entry, so ~671k charged 2025-06 trips picked up outside CRZ; the proxy undercounts, which is safe for a floor check.
